tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Paper Ground: the page. Also the 4px halo behind chart labels.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card Paper: unpressed buttons, segmented controls, hover labels. No tinted panel layer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Warm Ink: headlines, values, the ribbon's temperature trace, the pressed segment fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Soft Ink: standfirsts, source lines, dt labels, table headers, chart labels.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Faint Ink: axis ticks and range whiskers only.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline: axes, gridlines, row dividers, stat-strip borders.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Hairline Strong: control borders, table header rule, strip baselines.

tokens.name: rain-0
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, drizzle. Also the usual band behind every now-against-normal chart.

tokens.name: rain-1
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, light rain.

tokens.name: rain-2
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, moderate. Draws the dashed median.

tokens.name: rain-3
tokens.usage: Ledger Blue: the bold rain now-curve, selected-tab underline, the 3px focus ring, links.

tokens.name: rain-4
tokens.usage: Precipitation ramp, downpour.

tokens.name: temp-cold
tokens.usage: Temperature ramp, cold end.

tokens.name: temp-cool
tokens.usage: Temperature ramp, cool. Also the IQR bar in the periods chart.

tokens.name: temp-mild
tokens.usage: Temperature ramp, mild (stone).

tokens.name: temp-warm
tokens.usage: Temperature ramp, warm.

tokens.name: temp-hot
tokens.usage: Temperature ramp, hot (terracotta).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Sun Amber: solar marks. The solar now-line is 62% sun mixed with 38% ink.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Daylight on the ribbon; the usual band on solar charts.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The night band on the condition ribbon.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Claret Note: the finding only. The now rule, now dot, now label, current-month outline, live-event dot. One claret subject per section.

tokens.name: gap-a
tokens.usage: Gap hatch stripe: 135 degree stripes over gap-b mean not valid.

tokens.name: gap-b
tokens.usage: Gap hatch ground under gap-a stripes.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The current temperature only, tabular, with a superscript F at 0.4em. Live: clamp(2.75rem, 12vw, 3.5rem).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The hero lead's finding, max 30ch. 1.625rem from 1024px.
styles.sample: Raining now: 0.30 in so far, against 0.42 in for a usual event

styles.name: title
styles.sample: 59.3° now is above the middle half of yesterday's readings

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Rain over the last week, month and season

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The condition sentence and narrative, max 60ch.
styles.sample: Mild and lightly breezy; raining at 0.12 in/hr, 0.30 in so far today.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.usage: The one line under a headline that says how to read the chart. ink-2, max 62ch.
styles.sample: The bold line is this event's rain so far; the shaded band is the usual event.

styles.name: source
styles.usage: Source and method. ink-2. Proposed: the collapsed summary line of SourceNote.
styles.sample: Source: station archive · archived through 10:30 pm

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Right-now values and hero facts, tabular, above an ink-2 label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Keys, almanac headers, ribbon ticks, chips. 12px is the floor for any text.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: In-chart finding label, in note claret.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Headline to standfirst.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Stat-strip vertical padding; small gaps.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Standfirst to chart, chart to source.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; card-free block padding.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Gap under the tabs.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Between major sections; grid row gap.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Large page breaks.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Swatches, solar bars, strip cells.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Almanac cells, the condition ribbon, gap rows, invalid-window bars.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Segmented controls and buttons.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: The quality chip.
